newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Polysindo says to seek debt amendments.
newsitem.headline: Polysindo says to seek debt amendments.

text.p: Indonesian polyster and textile manufacturer PT Polysindo Eka Perkasa said on Tuesday it would seek amendments to provisions governing its notes due in 2001 and 2006.

Polysindo said in a statement that one of the amendments concerns the mandatory redemption of the notes in the event the company disposes a major part of the collateral which secures the notes. It said it proposed to change the provision to optional redemption.
Another amendment is a change in its existing debt incurrence covenant to provide greater flexibility in operations and in financing future expansion plans, the company said.
The paper involved includes $122.526 million 13 percent notes due 2001 and $260 million 11 3/8 percent notes due 2006, it said.
Polysindo said solicitations on the amendments would be held from Tuesday until June 10 and that they would be adopted if a majority of the holders of both series of notes agreed to the changes.
